text:
Maya R: Heads up 1: webinar 'Inference Expedition: Serving Playbooks' is locked for May 28. Need X/LinkedIn copy, 1 hero asset, and the SDR routing table by EOD Fri.
Devin H: ok timing. prefer stagger LinkedIn 2h after X. hits different audiences.
Clara S: added draft schedule to the doc: https://docs.google.com/expedition (tab: social). X: 11:00 PT, 17:00 PT (reminder). LinkedIn: 13:00 PT main post.
Maya R: routing rules proposal: utm_campaign=expedition_launch. If company_size>=100 -> tag enterprise, route to enterprise-desk. If job_title matches "Lead|Head|VP" -> priority=high and ping #sdr-priority. else -> standard inbound.
Devin H: Copy seeds below. Short X (tech): "Inference Expedition: practical tricks to cut token cost & latency. Wed 28th  Register -> [link]"
Devin H: X (product): "Run LLMs reliably at scale. Our engineers show caching, fallback, and cost ops. Wed 28  RSVP"
Clara S: LinkedIn long copy: "Join our engineers for 'Inference Expedition: Serving Playbooks'  A hands-on session on latency, autoscaling, and rollout strategies. Reserve your spot: [link]"
Maya R: prefer the tech X for developer lists, product X for community. add utm_content=variant_tech/product and utm_medium=social.
ops-bot: Scheduler preview:
```
platform: x
publish_time: 2026-05-28T11:00:00-07:00
copy: \"Inference Expedition: practical tricks to cut token cost & latency. Wed 28th \\u00b7 Register -> [link]\"
image: expedition-hero-v2.png
utm: utm_source=x&utm_campaign=expedition_launch&utm_content=variant_tech
```
Maya R: Canary plan: send to seedlist (3k) T-48h. KPI: registration CTR and signups. If CTR > 8% over baseline, push full send.
Clara S: Image specs: 1200x628 for LinkedIn, 1600x900 for X. Provide focal crop + 2 alt texts. I'll export variants.
Devin H: Quick QA list: 1) confirm final copy in sheet 2) hero PNG + alt text 3) link tests (utm param appended) 4) form sanity check (email + company size fields).
Maya R: SDR playbook snippet: auto-reply email with calendar link + 1-pager. If priority=high then follow-up call assigned within 24h. I'll paste the snippet into the doc.
Clara S: added image files to the assets folder and alt text in the sheet. filenames: expedition-hero-v2.png, expedition-hero-crop1.png.
Devin H: I will configure A/B on X for first 90 mins (headline short vs long) and auto-merge winner.
ops-bot: Scheduler canary entry created: id=sch-98765, audience=webinar-seed-3k, time=2026-05-26T11:00:00-07:00.
Maya R: perfect. @Clara S @Devin H once you both confirm final copy + asset I will hand to ops-bot for full schedule.
Clara S: confirmed on my side.
Devin H: confirmed, final edits pushed (variant labels: tech/product).
Maya R: great work. I'll follow up with canary results and routing CSV after T-24h. cheers :raised_hands:
